data.one_liner: Generate short YouTube-looking IDs from numbers and decode them back.
data.what_it_does: Generates short, URL-safe identifiers from one or several non-negative numbers using the Sqids algorithm. It allows customization of minimum length, custom alphabets, and blocklists to prevent specific words in generated IDs.
use_when: You need to generate public-facing IDs for URLs or link shortening
You want to encode internal sequential numbers into nonconsecutive IDs
avoid_when: You are handling sensitive data that requires proper encryption
You are generating user IDs where revealing the count of users via decoding is undesirable
strengths: URL safe with auto-generated prevention of common profanity
weaknesses: Multiple IDs can decode back into the same sequence of numbers, meaning they are not strictly canonical without manual checks
Not suitable for cryptography or sensitive data protection

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need universally unique identifiers (UUIDs) rather than short numeric ID hashes.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need actual cryptographic hashing functions like SHA or MD5.
